newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rio Tinto sells engineering unit to Bechtel.
newsitem.headline: Rio Tinto sells engineering unit to Bechtel.

text.p: Dual-listed mining giant Rio Tinto Ltd said on Thursday it is to sell as a going concern its Australian engineering subsidiary, Minenco, to the global engineering group Bechtel Corporation for an undisclosed sum.
The company said the transaction represented less than one percent of the group's assets and was subject to a number of conditions including government approvals.

"The decision to sell Minenco was one of a number of outcomes which have emerged from the review of Rio Tinto's worldwide technology group, foreshadowed with Rio Tinto's global re-organisation into product businesses," the company said.

Rio Tinto said its March review determined the company should remain at the leading edge of best practice in research and technology while strengthening its focus on the technical needs of the product businesses.
